analysis: The supplied PR changes in docs/reference/configuration.md are documentation-only: the 'Last updated' date (line 3), and an expanded description of `models[].resource_policy_sha256` (changed ranges around base/head line 964, with further ranges at 1104 and 1635-1636 outside the supplied units). The two supplied units (lines 485-949) are base context showing the unchanged environment-variable and cache configuration tables, and none of the changed lines fall inside them. No code, defaults, gates or controls are modified in the visible text. The documented cache controls remain consistent with T-041: TTL capped at 1800s, the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch, ephemeral-key fallback gated on explicit opt-in, the debug key file compiled only in DEBUG builds, and cache.directory/volume_uuid validation. The resource-policy hash description (patch excerpt, truncated) describes how the cluster runtime facts digest is computed, including a tensor-assistant field set. It adds no new trust surface by itself. Remaining uncertainty: the patch excerpt is truncated and the changed ranges at 1104 and 1635-1636 were not supplied, so those edits were not reviewed. Also, the accuracy of the documented hash composition against ClusterPublicTensorAssistant.resourcePolicyFields and DistributedInstalledNativeStart was not verifiable from the supplied evidence. This is a doc-accuracy concern, not a demonstrated security regression. No threat-model update appears required from the visible content.
